variants.task: Create /tmp/eval_nbody/nbody.py — Read from stdin: line 1 is the number of cases C (1 <= C <= 50). Each case: a line 'N dt steps' (1 <= N <= 8, 0 < dt <= 0.01, 1 <= steps <= 1000), then N lines 'mass x y vx vy' (2D position and velocity). Integrate with Velocity-Verlet and G=1.0: x(t+dt) = x(t) + v(t)*dt + 0.5*a(t)*dt^2; a_i = sum over j != i of G*m_j*(x_j - x_i)/|x_j - x_i|^3 (no softening; bodies stay at least 0.3 apart); v(t+dt) = v(t) + 0.5*(a(t) + a(t+dt))*dt. For each case output N lines, each 'x y vx vy' formatted to 6 decimals (positions and velocities after the final step). Grading runs hidden cases in this format with an absolute tolerance of 1e-5 per value; /tmp/eval_nbody/sample_input.txt and /tmp/eval_nbody/sample_output.txt are a worked sample. Pure Python (standard library only).
